build.axes: Blender Z up, forward -Y; glTF Y up, forward +Z; meters; runtime preserves existing actor height.
build.note: No bitmap was repainted or generated for these 3D adaptations. Original CC0 maps remain intact; material factors, normal maps, modeled surfaces and skeletal weights define the rendered appearance.
build.metadata: Each supporting actor writes <id>-model.json; CPP writes cpp-actions.json; the published runtime collection is ../../models/humans.json.

source_header_review.basis: Selected MHCLO and MHMAT headers explicitly state CC0 or the September 2020 MakeHuman CC0 release. Raster/OBJ companions inherit the selected asset license.
source_header_review.note: Those downloaded package headers say AGPL3 despite the package filename, and were not incorporated.

adaptations.cpp: Warm adult face, volumetric copper waves around crown and temples; rolled white shirt, dark fitted jeans, fingerless gloves, flower and round inheritance satchel. shoes03 is originally a low shoe plus sock: both surfaces are reshaped/recolored as a leather boot shaft and shoe, with brass laces ray-projected onto the fitted mesh and matching ankle weights.
adaptations.julia: Adult 22 reference: short dark curls, lavender rolled jacket, black camisole under the opening, charcoal cropped jeans, white sneakers and cream canvas bag. Inner garment inset prevents interpenetration.
adaptations.broker: Adult tailored charcoal suit, burgundy shirt, dark slicked hair and leather shoes. Shirt material follows the source UV area and chest bounds, preserving lapel edges.
adaptations.crowd: Eight independent adult macro/face/skin/hair/wardrobe recipes, preserving the existing palettes. Leather has modeled biker lapels/zippers and a short beard; Plum has a square neckline, long high braid and fitted continuous dress waist; Teal has a fuller Afro, a teal dress and sleeve weights extended through the elbow; LongCoat has gray hair/beard and a longer charcoal coat.
adaptations.wrist_bands: Cross-sections ray-projected onto each finished anatomical wrist, attached to lowerarm; existing glove/finger weights and materials preserved. See wrist-cuff-validation.json.
